defects_argued.quote: The impugned order, dated 12.02.2024 passed for the assessment year 2018-19 which stands quashed hereby, shall be treated as addendum to the show cause notices in DRC-01A, dated 26.10.2023 and DRC-01, dated 15.11.2023.

outcome.quote: Considering the same, I am inclined to grant partial relief to the petitioner by setting aside the impugned order and remitting the case to the 1st respondent to pass fresh order on merits.

review.notes: The court refers to both prior DRC-01A and DRC-01 notices and grants only partial relief on possible tax merits, rather than finding lack of notice. Coded the pleaded no-notice ground rejected and disposition partly_allowed.
